contentAfterToc.text: Introduction to White Label Solutions
What Are White Label Services?

children: White-label services mean you can offer a service to your client under your brand, but someone else does the work, and you will take credit for it. For example, if you offer website design to a client, but a different team builds it, and you deliver it with your name and logo, that’s white labeling.

contentAfterToc.text: How do I explain white-label services to my clients?

children: You don’t have to explain anything to your end client about your white-label partner. The client sees you as the service provider. The work is done under your name and brand. The whole credit goes to you, and your white-label partner charges you their fees only.

contentAfterToc.text: Do white-label developers follow SEO best practices?

children: The majority of good ones do. Ask them to show you the portfolio of their past work. Make sure they follow on-page SEO, fast loading, mobile-friendly design, and clean code.

contentAfterToc.text: What types of agencies can use white-label services?

children: Any agency that wants to scale—digital marketing, SEO, web design, or development agencies. It does not matter if you are a small company, a startup, or a well-settled company; you can use and take advantage of white-label services.

contentAfterToc.text: Is white-label development cheaper than hiring in-house?

children: Yes, you can say that. You don’t have to pay full-time salaries, benefits, or training costs. Only the services you use need to be paid for.
